Our Motivation: We saw a gap between dry classroom astronomy and unrealistic sci-fi games, and wanted to build something that makes real space science thrilling.

Why Roblox? To make STEM education truly accessible. Roblox allows anyone—regardless of their device—to jump straight into a multiplayer-ready environment without barriers.
summary:
Space is difficult to learn and teach, which often causes younger generations to lose interest in astronomy. To solve this, our project makes space exploration exciting and accessible through an educational game. Players design and execute their own missions while managing resources, assessing risks, and exploring the unique conditions of different celestial bodies.

Built on Roblox, the game turns players into mission commanders who must balance fuel, budget, and crew safety when planning launches, landings, and orbital manoeuvres. Each celestial body presents real scientific challenges — from the thin atmosphere of Mars to the crushing gravity of Jupiter's moons — encouraging players to research and apply genuine astronomical and physical concepts to succeed.

As missions grow more ambitious, players unlock new spacecraft, instruments, and destinations, creating a natural learning curve that rewards curiosity and strategic thinking. Failure is not punished but treated as a learning opportunity, with detailed debriefs explaining what went wrong and why.

By blending authentic science with engaging gameplay, the project transforms astronomy from an intimidating subject into a hands-on adventure, inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers.
details:
MissionForge is an interactive, educational space exploration game built on Roblox. Players take on the role of space explorers who must navigate the cosmos, complete critical space missions, and strategically manage finite survival resources—including food, water, and mission funding.

The Problem & Our Solution Space exploration is fascinating, yet physically inaccessible to students, and traditional textbook learning can often feel disconnected from reality. To bridge this gap, we brought space education directly to a platform where students are already active and engaged: Roblox. By leveraging Roblox’s massive, student-dominated ecosystem, our game lowers the barrier to STEM education, allowing learners to experience the realities and challenges of space travel firsthand from anywhere in the world.

Key Features & Creativity

  • Dynamic Resource Management: Survival in space requires careful planning. Players must balance their consumption of food, water, and team funds to keep their crew alive and operational.
  • Innovative Gameplay Mechanics: Our project stands out by introducing unique, creative methods for gathering and producing resources—particularly food—challenging players to think critically about sustainability in space.
  • Diverse Missions: A wide variety of missions ensures high replayability, presenting players with different cosmic challenges, problem-solving scenarios, and educational takeaways at every stage.
  • Player-Centric Design: Throughout development, our team prioritized accessibility, high interactivity, and a balanced difficulty curve to ensure the game remains approachable for beginners while offering enough challenge to keep experienced players invested.

How We Built It We developed the game using Roblox Studio, scripting the core mechanics, resource systems, and mission logic in Lua (Luau). To accelerate our workflow and troubleshoot complex mechanics, we utilized Roblox Studio’s built-in AI assistant alongside Claude.
